name: five-whys-runner
description: Runs evidence-backed root-cause laddering on a chosen pain, part of the Design Thinking Pack by 90n. Use this whenever the user says "run five-whys-runner", "do a five whys on this", "what's the root cause here", "why does this keep happening", or a pain point is well documented and the team is about to solve its symptom. Use it even for "users keep abandoning at checkout and we don't know why".
